# PLAN — iteration 1

## Current state assessment

The incumbent is timing-feasible at 40 LUTs and 28 FFs, with WNS 0.702 ns and WHS 0.141 ns, so promotion requires a strict LUT reduction after all fixed verification and report-integrity gates pass. The editable seed is only a wrapper around the frozen core; no prior trial outcomes are provided. The top’s known latency requires `// @latency 1`.

## Hypothesis

Inlining the core into the editable top and removing the reset assignment to the internal data register may reduce reset-related logic while preserving observable behavior, which must be confirmed in routed reports.

## Instruction for generator

Replace the top’s child instantiation with equivalent UART logic inside `uart_tx`, preserving the fixed interface, cycle timing, registered outputs, and synchronous reset behavior. Keep reset priority for all externally observable state, but leave the internal data register unreset; it is loaded on every accepted byte before its contents can affect `tx`. Preserve `// @latency 1`; retain the candidate only if simulation, all other deterministic gates, and routed timing pass, and routed LUT use is strictly below 40.
